question: How do fixed-base settlement cash flows differ from summed funding rates across every original symbol and role, and what capital-cost break-even follows under the unchanged 32-bp execution sensitivity?
selection: All 17 original selected symbols and all three original role endpoints. No winner selection, resampling, alternate holding period, market request, protected data, bootstrap rerun or promotion.
prior_outcome_access: The old family failure and BTC role summary were inspected before this plan. This is explicitly not a prospective independent validation.
raw_scope: Only the 17 funding-history responses named and hash-bound by the original result; do not open its top books, selection snapshots or any other outcomes.

accounting.quantity: One base unit held fixed per role; the notional changes with each mark.
accounting.funding_cash_quote: sum(fundingRate_t * markPrice_t) for the short; no funding reinvestment.
accounting.normalization_reference: The immediately preceding retained funding mark before each original role. It is a scale reference, not an executable entry price.
accounting.duration: Original role duration_days, unchanged; not a newly asserted exact holding duration.
accounting.execution_sensitivity: Original 32 bps deducted once per original role on the reference notional, not measured commission.
accounting.capital_cost: Original 1000 annual bps on each of two reference-notional legs retained as a labeled stress; derive break-even annual bps per leg algebraically, without changing any gate.
accounting.omissions: Entry/exit basis, executable spot prices, actual commissions, spread/depth, custody, mark-to-market liquidity, liquidation, capital variation, taxes, and account eligibility. Positive funding cash is not total strategy PnL.

validation: Require original self-hashes and raw hashes, exact symbol identity, unique ascending integer timestamps, finite positive marks, finite rates, original role row count/endpoints and reconstructed original unweighted gross rate sums. Stop on mismatch without rerun or request.
outcome: One exclusive output and durable journal. Preserve all old implementations/results and canonical status; no model or edge acceptance may follow. This audit can identify a better specification or establish that even the simpler cash-flow gate fails.
